title: Ensure the organization is verified
description: Not applicable to Azure DevOps: verification badges prove ownership of a public organization identity on hosted platforms that have one, and Azure DevOps has no such badge. Carried as an explicit NA so the mapping is documented rather than missing.
remediation: No action applies: Azure DevOps has no organization verification badge. The nearest equivalent is connecting the organization to your own Microsoft Entra tenant at Organization settings -> Microsoft Entra, which ties every identity in it to a directory you control.
fixSummary: No action applies; connect your tenant at Organization settings -> Microsoft Entra.
